Before you book.

General Guidelines+
  • Listed price is per hour, per bay, exclusive of tax
  • 1–4 guests per bay
  • AVID GOLF recommends 45–60 minutes per person for a full 18-hole experience. Factors include player ability, driving range warm-up, game settings such as "Auto-Putt" and "Double-Par," software familiarity, and pace-of-play
  • Bay billings are rounded up to the nearest 5 minutes
  • Booking slot ends 5 minutes early for staff and next-customer convenience
  • Guests are responsible for the full length of their stay, including overtime
  • AVID GOLF reserves the right to move a booking to a different bay to optimize the tee sheet — note preferred features in the booking "notes" section
  • AVID GOLF reserves the right to open late or close early if no customers are booked on the tee sheet
Equipment & What to Bring+
  • Golfers are expected to bring their own clubs, or rent clubs from AVID GOLF ($10/hr)
  • Clubs must be clean; spikeless shoes are required
  • If using your own golf balls (instead of AVID GOLF's supplied Titleist Pro V1s), balls must be white, un-marked, and in new condition
  • Walk-ins are accepted, but availability is not guaranteed — booking is strongly recommended
  • Club Member preferred pricing may apply — see Club Membership for details
  • Coaching sessions include golf simulator bay rentals
Cancellation Policy+
  • Single-bay bookings: 24 hours notice required
  • Acceptable cancellation channels are phone only: 1-204-505-2843 and email: info@avidgolf.club
Group Bookings+
  • 2–6 golf simulator bay rentals available (including the option to rent out all of AVID GOLF)
  • Contact us to arrange side-by-side bays and all other party details
  • Credit cards are required to book multiple bays but will only be charged in the case of a no-show
  • Cancellation policy is "1 day per bay" — e.g., a 3-bay booking requires 72 hours notice for cancellations or modifications
  • If a group booking is cancelled or downsized with insufficient notice, AVID GOLF reserves the right to process 100% of the credit card hold
